description: This file defines the HelpSearch class, a Drupal plugin for searching help topics using the Search module index. It manages search execution, indexing, permission checks, and integration with help section plugins.

classes.name: HelpSearch
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for searching help topics using the Search module index, handling search execution, indexing, permissions, and integration with help sections.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the HelpSearch plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies such as database, config, language manager, messenger, account, state, help section manager, and search index.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access help pages.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID representing the type of search.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the search and returns prepared results or an empty array.

methods.name: findResults
methods.description: Builds and executes the search query, applying permissions and language restrictions, returning search results.

methods.name: prepareResults
methods.description: Prepares raw database results into renderable search result arrays with links and snippets.

methods.name: updateIndex
methods.description: Updates the search index by indexing new or reindexed help topics.

methods.name: indexClear
methods.description: Clears the entire help search index.

methods.name: updateTopicList
methods.description: Rebuilds the list of help topics to be indexed, adding new topics and updating permissions.

methods.name: updateIndexState
methods.description: Updates the count of unindexed help topics in the state variable.

methods.name: markForReindex
methods.description: Marks the entire help index for reindexing.

methods.name: indexStatus
methods.description: Returns the total and remaining number of help topics to be indexed.

methods.name: removeItemsFromIndex
methods.description: Removes specified help topics from the search index and database table.

methods.name: getSectionPlugin
methods.description: Creates and verifies a help section plugin instance for searchability.
